question: What division into octads of eight is sought to be fully known?
premises: A division is the object of inquiry.
The division consists of octads of eight.
The aim is to know it fully and completely.
inference: The speaker seeks to fully know the division into octads of eight in its entirety.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the octads of eight is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: I wish to know fully and completely the division into octads of eight.
